About the OpportunityPragmatike is partnering with a fast-growing technology company to hire an experienced DevOps Engineer.
This is an opportunity to join a highly technical engineering team building and operating modern cloud-native infrastructure at scale. You'll work on automation, platform reliability, observability, and deployment systems that support mission-critical applications used globally.
We're looking for someone who thrives in fast-moving startup environments, enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, and takes ownership of systems from design through production operations.

What You'll Do• Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure across production environments.

• Improve platform reliability, scalability, security, and performance.

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.

• Manage Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads.

• Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability best practices.

• Collaborate closely with software engineers to improve developer experience and platform efficiency.

• Automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure-as-Code tools.

• Drive incident response, root cause analysis, and operational excellence initiatives.

• Contribute to security, compliance, and disaster recovery processes.

• Support a culture of continuous improvement, automation, and engineering excellence.

What We're Looking For• 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering roles.

• Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

• Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes and Docker.

• Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines.

• Strong scripting or programming skills (Python, Go, Bash, or similar).

• Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools.

• Strong understanding of networking, Linux systems, and cloud security principles.

• Experience with monitoring and observability tools.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a fully remote environment.

Nice to Have• Experience supporting high-growth SaaS platforms.

• Multi-cloud experience.

• Experience with distributed systems and large-scale production environments.

• Security, compliance, or infrastructure governance experience.

• Previous startup or scale-up experience.

Why Join?You'll join a product-focused engineering team where infrastructure is considered a strategic advantage. The environment is collaborative, fast-paced, and highly technical, offering significant ownership and the opportunity to influence how systems are designed, operated, and scaled.

Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely, and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration. You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time. We are committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your information throughout the recruitment process.

Company Description

SYSTABUILD is building a shared cloud and platform foundation for a group of software companies in the construction, CAD and ERP domain.
To support this platform, we are looking for a Junior DevOps CI/CD Engineer who is passionate about developer tooling, automation, and modern software delivery.
In this role, you will work at the heart of our development infrastructure, helping teams build, test, and ship software reliably and efficiently.

Job Description

• Support and further develop CI/CD pipelines across multiple teams and repositories.
• Operate and improve our development tooling landscape, including Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, and SonarQube.
• Help standardize pipelines, templates, and workflows to improve developer experience and quality.
• Assist in integrating quality gates, security checks, and automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
• Work closely with development teams to troubleshoot pipeline issues and improve build reliability.
• Support the migration and integration of repositories, pipelines, and tooling across the SYSTABUILD group.
• Document tooling, processes, and best practices to enable self-service for development teams.
• Learn and grow towards more advanced DevOps and platform engineering responsibilities.

Qualifications

• First hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, for example using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitHub Enterprise, or similar tools.
• Good experience with scripting or automation (for example Bash, PowerShell, or Python).
• Basic understanding of modern software development workflows (Git, pull requests, branching strategies).
• Initial experience with build and test automation for at least one programming ecosystem (for example .NET, Delphi or C++).
• Familiarity with code quality tools such as SonarQube or similar static analysis solutions.
• Basic understanding of infrastructure and cloud concepts.
• Willingness to learn Infrastructure as Code, security practices, and cloud-native tooling.
• Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

Nice To Have
• Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) organizations, pipelines, or boards.
• First exposure to GitHub Enterprise administration or repository management.
• Familiarity with container technologies such as Docker.
• Interest in cloud platforms, especially AWS.

Traits We Value
• Curiosity and eagerness to learn new tools and technologies.
• A structured and reliable working style.
• A strong sense of responsibility for shared systems.
• Openness to feedback and continuous improvement.
• Motivation to grow into a more senior DevOps or platform engineering role.

Additional Information

• A competitive salary package
• Individual training and development opportunities
• Flexibility in balancing office hours and remote work
• Wellpass, JobRad, and much more..
